media:group.media:title: Perfect Popcorn (5 years refined)🍿
media:group.media:description:
Mike G’s “Cheezy” Popcorn Seasoning
Ingredients: -1 cup nutritional yeast -1/4 cup kosher salt -1 tablespoon garlic powder -1 tablespoon onion powder -1 tablespoon paprika
Instructions: Add all ingredients to a spice grinder or blender and blend until the mixture becomes a fine powder. A finer texture will coat the popcorn more evenly and give you the best flavor in every bite. Store in an airtight container for up to several months.
